metadata.description: The name of the Sentinel workspace

properties.displayName: Authentication — Downgrade Attack on Auth Protocol
properties.description: Detects authentication protocol downgrade from Kerberos to NTLM indicating potential downgrade attacks
properties.query: SecurityEvent | where EventID == 4624 | where AuthenticationPackageName == "NTLM" | where TargetUserName !endswith "$" | summarize count() by bin(TimeGenerated, 10m), TargetUserName, IpAddress | join kind=inner (SecurityEvent | where EventID == 4624 | where AuthenticationPackageName == "Kerberos" | where TargetUserName !endswith "$" | summarize count() by TargetUserName) on TargetUserName | where count_ > 5
